info.name: Properties API Tests
info.description:
Postman collection for Properties module test automation. Based on server/testing/properties.md

## Validation Rules
- name: min 10, max 50
- description: min 50, max 100
- address: min 20, max 50
- city: min 5, max 20
- ward: min 5, max 20
- district: min 5, max 20

## Usage
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Select environment with {{base_url}}, {{test_password}}, etc.
3. Update {{base_url}} if needed
4. Run requests in order or use Collection Runner

## Cleanup
Before running, ensure supabase_project_ref and service_role_key are set in your environment for cleanup.

item.description:
Xóa tất cả test properties và users đã tạo trong session.

Set 2 biến trong environment (Current Value):
- `supabase_project_ref`: Ví dụ `https://xyzabc.supabase.co`
- `service_role_key`: Service role key từ Supabase Dashboard → Settings → API

Chạy request, cleanup sẽ loop qua từng ID và gọi DELETE qua Supabase Admin API / REST API.
